text: This is the word that Jeremiah (whom YHWH has appointed) the prophet spoke to Baruch (blessed) son of Neriah (lamp of YHWH) when he wrote these words on a scroll at the dictation of Jeremiah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim (YHWH raises up) son of Josiah (whom YHWH heals), king of Judah (praised):
“This is what the LORD, the God {YHWH Elohe} of Israel (he wrestles with God), says to you, Baruch (blessed):
You have said, ‘Woe is me because the LORD {YHWH} has added sorrow to my pain! I am worn out with groaning and have found no rest.’”
Thus Jeremiah was to say to Baruch \Thus you shall say to him:/: “This is what the LORD {YHWH} says: Throughout the land I will demolish what I have built and uproot what I have planted.

But as for you, do you seek great things for yourself? Stop seeking! For I will bring disaster on every living creature, declares the LORD {YHWH}, but wherever you go, I will grant your life as a spoil of war.”
